analysis_layer.principle: Selection and analysis are distinct. A company may be discovered by one or more systems, then analyzed through existing TradingAgents plus system-specific methodology context.

explicit_non_goals_of_l0_freeze: define Technology KB or Technology scanner rules

governance.change_control: Any L0 change requires mechanical contradiction or new owner business decision, explicit owner approval, and a new version. Implementation convenience is not authority.

dynamic_evidence_plane.raw_news_retention_rule: Do not permanently retain the full raw stream by default; retain bounded event capsules/material state changes and rehydrate live sources when deep attribution is needed.

shared_intelligence_plane.purpose: Provide current facts/data to all systems through source/provider adapters.
shared_intelligence_plane.rule: Facts may be shared. Selection standards and methodology interpretations remain system-specific.

static_methodology_plane.rule: Do not mix transient news streams into static methodology knowledge.

methodology_kb.incremental_enrichment: Governed future enrichment only; not part of this architecture-freeze mission.

PRADEEP.scanner_rule_authority: Must be derived from frozen first-party Pradeep methodology evidence into a future scanner-rule contract. Old UI placeholder rules are not authority.
selection_funnel: TradingAgents analysis with Pradeep methodology grounding

allowed_now: reserve Technology as a distinct selection-system identity
reserve an interface to publish candidates/evidence into the unified candidate layer
reserve an interface to provide technology analysis context to analysis orchestration
freeze the high-level dynamic tracking pattern without freezing schemas/rules
forbidden_now: invent Technology KB content/schema from assumptions
implement company tracking before Technology KB authority exists
treat public-company ticker as the canonical company identity because private companies must also be supported

TRADITIONAL.analysis_status: Existing TradingAgents capabilities must be mechanically mapped before any claim of completeness.
TRADITIONAL.independence: Independent selection standards, typically factor/fundamental/market filters and traditional analysis.

ui_information_architecture.capability_truthfulness: Every not-yet-connected feature must be labeled not connected; UI must not present placeholder rules as live behavior.
ui_information_architecture.principle: UI architecture is frozen now; individual feature connectivity is staged.

unified_candidate_layer.purpose: Converge outputs without erasing system provenance.
required_semantics: preserve multiple independent system matches for the same company
